# fig. S2a

Fold-change ranking of newly detected CDR3β clonotypes used to define an empirical expansion cutoff.

A criteria is that they were absent in previous time-points.

```{r}

patient <- pbl$RIO136
clonotype_by <- "aminoAcid"
floor_y <- 1e-3
fc_cutoff <- 10
min_count <- 5
fc_all <- get_newly_detected_fc_all(
  patient_list = patient,
  floor_y = floor_y,
  clonotype_by = clonotype_by,
  min_count = min_count
)
cut_fc <- apply_newly_detected_fc_cutoff(
  fc_all = fc_all,
  fc_cutoff = fc_cutoff,
  fc_col = "fc_vs_previous_floor"
)

plots_list[["rank_pbl_non_neutral"]] <- plot_newly_detected_fc_rank_cutoff(
  cutoff_result = cut_fc,
  fc_col = "fc_vs_previous_floor",
  point_size = 0.25,
  selected_point_size = 2,
  shape_by_time = FALSE
)

plots_list[["rank_pbl_non_neutral_zoom"]] <- plot_non_neutral_rankplot_zoom(
  cutoff_result = cut_fc,
  fc_col = "fc_vs_previous_floor",
  point_size = 3
)

```

# fig. S4a

## annot

First, annotate each ID on the TCR library based on its selection criteria, i.e., expanded, til, PD1 or frequent. Of note, the TCR library was constructed based on pre and post2 (day 42) samples.

Steps:

Load repertoire combining both TCR-Seq runs.

```{r}
samples <- c("Rootpath/pre_bulk1",
             "Rootpath/pre_bulk2",
             "Rootpath/pre_bulk3",
             "Rootpath/pre_pd1",
             "Rootpath/post2_d42_bulk1",
             "Rootpath/post2_d42_bulk2",
             "Rootpath/post2_d42_bulk3",
             "Rootpath/post2_d42_pd1"
             )
repertoire <- list()
for (i in samples) {
  contig_file <- file.path(
    "/Volumes/datos_lab/single_cell/RIO136",
    i,
    "filtered_contig_annotations.csv"
  )

  if (!file.exists(contig_file)) {
    stop("Missing filtered contig annotation file: ", contig_file)
  }

  contig_data <- data.table::fread(contig_file)
  required_contig_columns <- c(
    "barcode",
    "v_gene",
    "j_gene",
    "cdr3",
    "chain",
    "productive"
  )
  missing_contig_columns <- setdiff(
    required_contig_columns,
    colnames(contig_data)
  )

  if (length(missing_contig_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in ",
      contig_file,
      ": ",
      paste(missing_contig_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  data <- contig_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(productive %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE")) %>%
    dplyr::select(barcode, v_gene, j_gene, cdr3, chain) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      chain_order = match(chain, c("TRA", "TRB"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(barcode, chain_order, chain) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(barcode) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      v_gene = paste(v_gene, collapse = ";"),
      j_gene = paste(j_gene, collapse = ";"),
      cdr3 = paste(cdr3, collapse = ";"),
      chain = paste(chain, collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sample = gsub("Rootpath/", "", i))

  repertoire[[i]] <- data
}
repertoire <- dplyr::bind_rows(repertoire)
```

Internal control: Number of TCR clonotypes in CD3+ and CD3+PD1hi populations.

```{r}

clonotype_counts_total <- repertoire %>%
  mutate(
    source = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "bulk") ~ "bulk",
      str_detect(sample, "pd1") ~ "pd1",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    clonotype = paste(v_gene, j_gene, cdr3, sep = "__")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(source)) %>%
  distinct(source, clonotype) %>%
  dplyr::count(source, name = "n_distinct_clonotypes")
clonotype_counts_total

```


Define TCR clonotypes & count.

```{r}

repertoire <- repertoire %>% mutate(clonotype = paste(cdr3, v_gene, j_gene, sep = "_"))
clonotype_counts <- repertoire %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_starts(sample, "pre_") ~ "pre",
      str_starts(sample, "post2_") ~ "post2",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("pre", "post2"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint)) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, clonotype) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = n_cells,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(full_pre = pre, full_post2 = post2) %>%
  dplyr::select(clonotype, full_pre, full_post2)
repertoire <- repertoire %>% left_join(clonotype_counts, by = "clonotype")

```

Summary table with tumor annotations.

```{r}

# --- Define TRB clonotypes & count ---
# Multi-chain cells such as TRA;TRB;TRB contribute every TRB CDR3B.
repertoire.trb.long <- make_sc_trb_long(repertoire)

# --- Tumor CDR3B set ---
tumor_CDR3B <- biopsy$RIO136$`p136-Tfrozen_TCRB in frame` %>%
  filter(!is.na(aminoAcid), aminoAcid != "NA") %>%
  pull(aminoAcid) %>%
  unique()

# --- Single-cell CDR3B table ---
repertoire.clean <- repertoire.trb.long %>%
  mutate(
    compartment = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, regex("bulk", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Bulk",
      str_detect(sample, regex("PD1", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PD1",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    tumor = CDR3B %in% tumor_CDR3B
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CDR3B), CDR3B != "", !is.na(compartment)) %>%
  dplyr::select(CDR3B, compartment, tumor) %>%
  distinct()

```

Add TCR library information.

```{r}

# --- Load the TCR library ---
tcr_lib_file <- "/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/libraries/final/RIO136/tcr_lib.txt"

if (!file.exists(tcr_lib_file)) {
  stop("Missing TCR library file: ", tcr_lib_file)
}

tcr_lib <- data.table::fread(tcr_lib_file, header = FALSE)

if (!all(c("V1", "V2") %in% colnames(tcr_lib))) {
  stop("The TCR library file must contain at least two columns: V1 and V2")
}

# --- Add reconstructed TCRs ---
tcr_lib <- rbind(
  tcr_lib,
  data.table::data.table(
    V1 = c(
      "CASSLIGASGNTEAFF_TRBV5-1_TRBJ1-1",
      "CASSLATGASTDTQYF_TRBV7-8_TRBJ2-3",
      "CASTTGFGNTEAFF_TRBV28_TRBJ1-1",
      "CAISELGTGNNEQFF_TRBV10-3_TRBJ2-1"
    ),
    V2 = c(
      "ValidationID.15",
      "ValidationID.25",
      "ValidationID.34",
      "ValidationID.45"
    )
  ),
  fill = TRUE
)

# --- Standardize TCR IDs ---
tcr_lib <- tcr_lib %>%
  mutate(
    V2 = gsub("Chosen", "", V2),
    V2 = gsub("ValidationID\\.", "#", V2),
    V2_num = str_extract(V2, "[0-9]+$"),
    V2_prefix = case_when(
      grepl("^ID\\.[0-9]+$", V2) ~ "ID.",
      grepl("^#[0-9]+$", V2) ~ "#",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    V2 = if_else(
      !is.na(V2_prefix) & !is.na(V2_num),
      paste0(V2_prefix, sprintf("%03d", as.integer(V2_num))),
      V2
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-V2_num, -V2_prefix)

# --- TCRlib experiment annotation ---
tcrlib_yes_ids <- sprintf("ID.%03d", c(12, 16, 23, 24, 31, 60, 83, 94, 143, 146, 159, 187, 347, 531, 572, 618, 640))
tcrlib_autoreactive_ids <- sprintf("ID.%03d", c(195, 214, 232, 295, 440, 445, 525, 684))
tcrlib_no_ids <- sprintf("ID.%03d", c(484))

# --- Trajectory experiment annotation ---
traj_yes_ids <- sprintf("ID.%03d", c(145, 185, 746))
traj_autoreactive_ids <- sprintf("ID.%03d", c(82, 148, 247, 216))
traj_no_autoreactivity_tested_ids <- c(sprintf("ID.%03d", c(2, 74, 99)), sprintf("#%03d", c(25, 45)))
traj_no_ids <- c(sprintf("ID.%03d", c(35, 56, 57, 131, 136, 198, 217, 272, 285, 646, 664, 671, 819)), sprintf("#%03d", c(15, 34)))
traj_ids <- unique(c(traj_yes_ids, traj_autoreactive_ids, traj_no_autoreactivity_tested_ids, traj_no_ids))

# --- Annotate both experiments without overwriting ---
tcr_lib <- tcr_lib %>%
  mutate(
    TCRlib_hit = TRUE,
    TCRlib_reactivity = case_when(
      V2 %in% tcrlib_yes_ids ~ "Yes",
      V2 %in% tcrlib_autoreactive_ids ~ "Auto-reactive",
      V2 %in% tcrlib_no_ids ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    TCRlib_color = case_when(
      TCRlib_reactivity == "Yes" ~ "red3",
      TCRlib_reactivity == "Auto-reactive" ~ "black",
      TCRlib_reactivity == "No" ~ "gray70",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Traj = V2 %in% traj_ids,
    Traj_reactivity = case_when(
      V2 %in% traj_yes_ids ~ "Yes",
      V2 %in% traj_autoreactive_ids ~ "Auto-reactive",
      V2 %in% traj_no_autoreactivity_tested_ids ~ "No-autoreactivity-tested",
      V2 %in% traj_no_ids ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Traj_color = case_when(
      Traj_reactivity == "Yes" ~ "red3",
      Traj_reactivity == "Auto-reactive" ~ "black",
      Traj_reactivity == "No-autoreactivity-tested" ~ "#C2A679",
      Traj_reactivity == "No" ~ "gray70",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# --- Collapse TCR library information by CDR3B and add it to single-cell clonotypes ---
tcr_lib_CDR3B <- tcr_lib %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(!is.na(V1), V1 != "NA") %>%
  mutate(CDR3B = str_extract(V1, "^[^_]+")) %>%
  group_by(CDR3B) %>%
  summarise(
    TCRlib_ID = collapse_uniq(V2),
    TCRlib_hit = any(TCRlib_hit %in% TRUE),
    TCRlib_reactivity = collapse_uniq(TCRlib_reactivity),
    TCRlib_color = collapse_uniq(TCRlib_color),
    Traj = any(Traj %in% TRUE),
    Traj_reactivity = collapse_uniq(Traj_reactivity),
    Traj_color = collapse_uniq(Traj_color),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Add TCR library information to single-cell clonotypes ---
repertoire.clean <- repertoire.clean %>%
  left_join(tcr_lib_CDR3B, by = "CDR3B") %>%
  mutate(
    TCRlib_hit = replace_na(TCRlib_hit, FALSE),
    Traj = replace_na(Traj, FALSE)
  )

```

Rank single-cell clonotypes by frequency fold-change (day 42 vs baseline).

```{r}

sc_fc_rank <- get_sc_reference_fc_rank(
  patient_list = patient,
  single_cell_clonotypes = repertoire.clean,
  floor_y = 1e-3,
  clonotype_by = "aminoAcid",
  timepoint_0 = "d0",
  timepoint_42 = "d42"
)

required_sc_fc_columns <- c(
  "CDR3B",
  "FC_abs",
  "FC_direction",
  "rank",
  "log2FC_abs",
  "timepoint",
  "freq_in",
  "reference_freq",
  "reference_timepoint",
  "reference_count",
  "count"
)
missing_sc_fc_columns <- setdiff(
  required_sc_fc_columns,
  colnames(sc_fc_rank)
)

if (length(missing_sc_fc_columns) > 0) {
```

Internal control: Check where the tumour-reactive TCRs fall. FC of 10 would capture 8/17 (~50%) of the TCRlib hits.

```{r}

# I tried several cutoff values, but FC10 seems to be the best compromise between sensitivity and specificity.
fc.value <- 10

p_sc_fc_rank <- plot_sc_clonotype_fc_rank(sc_fc_rank, fc_cutoff = fc.value)
p_sc_fc_rank

```

Annotate the expanding or contracting clonotypes based on the selected fold-change filter.

```{r}

# --- Filter by fold-change value ---
expanding_FC <- sc_fc_rank %>%
  filter(FC_abs >= fc.value, FC_direction %in% c("Expansion", "Contraction")) %>%
  arrange(desc(FC_abs)) %>%
  mutate(expanding_FC = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CDR3B,
    expanding_FC,
    rank,
    FC_abs,
    log2FC_abs,
    FC_direction,
    timepoint,
    freq_in,
    reference_freq,
    reference_timepoint,
    tumor,
    TCRlib_ID,
    TCRlib_hit,
    TCRlib_reactivity,
    TCRlib_color,
    Traj,
    Traj_reactivity,
    Traj_color
  )

# --- Annotate the repertoire ---
repertoire.clean <- repertoire.clean %>%
  mutate(
    expanding = CDR3B %in% expanding_FC$CDR3B,
    criteria = paste(
      compartment,
      ifelse(tumor %in% TRUE, "Tumor", "No tumor"),
      ifelse(expanding %in% TRUE, "Expanding", "Non-expanding"),
      sep = " | "
    )
  )

```

Simplified criteria.

```{r}

count_cutoff <- 3
high_count_baseline_day42_tbl <- sc_fc_rank %>%
  mutate(
    max_count_baseline_day42 = pmax(
      coalesce(reference_count, 0),
      coalesce(count, 0)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(max_count_baseline_day42 >= count_cutoff) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_count_baseline_day42), desc(FC_abs))

repertoire.clean <- repertoire.clean %>%
  mutate(
    high_count_baseline_day42 = CDR3B %in% high_count_baseline_day42_tbl$CDR3B,
    criteria = paste(
      compartment,
      ifelse(tumor %in% TRUE, "Tumor", "No tumor"),
      ifelse(expanding %in% TRUE, "Expanding", "Non-expanding"),
      ifelse(high_count_baseline_day42 %in% TRUE, "High-count baseline/d42", "Low-count baseline/d42"),
      sep = " | "
    ),
    criteria_simplified = case_when(
      compartment == "PD1" & tumor %in% TRUE & expanding %in% TRUE ~ "PD1 | Tumor | Expanding",
      compartment == "PD1" & tumor %in% TRUE ~ "PD1 | Tumor",
      compartment == "PD1" & expanding %in% TRUE ~ "PD1 | Expanding",
      tumor %in% TRUE & expanding %in% TRUE ~ "Tumor | Expanding",
      compartment == "PD1" ~ "PD1",
      tumor %in% TRUE ~ "Tumor",
      expanding %in% TRUE ~ "Expanding",
      high_count_baseline_day42 %in% TRUE ~ "Frequent",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    )
  )

```

Subset the TCRs included in the TCR library

```{r}

# --- Subset the repertoire to TCR library hits ---
repertoire.clean.sub <- repertoire.clean %>%
  filter(TCRlib_hit %in% TRUE) %>%
  arrange(
    criteria_simplified,
    CDR3B
  )
repertoire.clean.sub.prioritized <- repertoire.clean.sub
table(repertoire.clean.sub$criteria_simplified)

# --- Internal control ---
TCRlib_ID_list <- repertoire.clean.sub.prioritized %>%
  filter(!is.na(TCRlib_ID), TCRlib_ID != "") %>%
  separate_rows(TCRlib_ID, sep = "\\s*\\|\\s*") %>%
  mutate(TCRlib_ID = str_trim(TCRlib_ID)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(TCRlib_ID, "^ID\\.\\d+$")) %>%
  distinct(TCRlib_ID) %>%
  arrange(TCRlib_ID) %>%
  pull(TCRlib_ID)
message("Total number of TCR library IDs annotated: ", length(TCRlib_ID_list))

```

Return criteria to the library.

```{r}

criteria_by_TCRlib_ID <- repertoire.clean.sub.prioritized %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$TCRlib_ID),
    .data$TCRlib_ID != ""
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(
    TCRlib_ID,
    sep = "\\s*\\|\\s*"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TCRlib_ID = stringr::str_trim(.data$TCRlib_ID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(
      .data$TCRlib_ID,
      "^(ID\\.|#)\\d+$"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$TCRlib_ID
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    CDR3B_sc = collapse_uniq(.data$CDR3B),
    is_PD1 = any(
      .data$compartment == "PD1",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    is_tumor = any(
      .data$tumor %in% TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    is_expanding = any(
      .data$expanding %in% TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    is_frequent = any(
      .data$high_count_baseline_day42 %in% TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    criteria_simplified = purrr::pmap_chr(
      list(
        .data$is_PD1,
        .data$is_tumor,
        .data$is_expanding,
        .data$is_frequent
      ),
      function(
        is_PD1,
        is_tumor,
        is_expanding,
        is_frequent
      ) {
        x <- c(
          if (isTRUE(is_PD1)) "PD1" else character(0),
          if (isTRUE(is_tumor)) "Tumor" else character(0),
          if (isTRUE(is_expanding)) "Expanding" else character(0)
        )
        if (length(x) > 0) {
          paste(
            x,
            collapse = " | "
          )
        } else if (isTRUE(is_frequent)) {
          "Frequent"
        } else {
          "None"
        }
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    V2 = TCRlib_ID
  )
tcr_lib.annotated <- tcr_lib %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    V1 = as.character(.data$V1),
    V2 = as.character(.data$V2),
    CDR3B = stringr::str_extract(
      .data$V1,
      "^[^_]+"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    criteria_by_TCRlib_ID,
    by = "V2"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_repertoire_clean = !is.na(.data$criteria_simplified),
    criteria_simplified = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$V2 == "#015" ~ "PD1 | Expanding",
      .data$V2 == "#025" ~ "PD1",
      .data$V2 == "#034" ~ "PD1 | Expanding",
      .data$V2 == "#045" ~ "PD1 | Expanding",
      TRUE ~ .data$criteria_simplified
    ),
    criteria_simplified = tidyr::replace_na(
      .data$criteria_simplified,
      "Not found"
    ),
    TCRlib_reactivity_plot = tidyr::replace_na(
      .data$TCRlib_reactivity,
      "NA"
    ),
    Traj_reactivity_plot = tidyr::replace_na(
      .data$Traj_reactivity,
      "NA"
    )
  )
# --- Internal control ---
base::table(
  tcr_lib.annotated$criteria_simplified,
  tcr_lib.annotated$TCRlib_reactivity_plot
)
base::table(
  tcr_lib.annotated$criteria_simplified,
  tcr_lib.annotated$Traj_reactivity_plot
)
```

Distribution of CDR3Bs matching TCR library IDs, tagged by category.

```{r}

criteria_by_CDR3B <- tcr_lib.annotated %>%
  mutate(CDR3B = as.character(CDR3B),
         V2 = as.character(V2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CDR3B), CDR3B != "",
         !is.na(V2), V2 != "") %>%
  group_by(CDR3B) %>%
  summarise(
    TCRlib_ID_plot = collapse_uniq(V2),
    is_PD1 = any(stringr::str_detect(criteria_simplified, stringr::regex("(^| \\| )PD1($| \\| )")), na.rm = TRUE),
    is_tumor = any(stringr::str_detect(criteria_simplified, stringr::regex("(^| \\| )Tumor($| \\| )")), na.rm = TRUE),
    is_expanding = any(stringr::str_detect(criteria_simplified, stringr::regex("(^| \\| )Expanding($| \\| )")), na.rm = TRUE),
    is_frequent = any(criteria_simplified == "Frequent", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    criteria_simplified = purrr::pmap_chr(
      list(is_PD1, is_tumor, is_expanding, is_frequent),
      function(is_PD1, is_tumor, is_expanding, is_frequent) {
        x <- c(
          if (is_PD1) "PD1" else character(0),
          if (is_tumor) "Tumor" else character(0),
          if (is_expanding) "Expanding" else character(0)
        )
        if (length(x) > 0) {
          paste(x, collapse = " | ")
        } else if (is_frequent) {
          "Frequent"
        } else {
          "None"
        }
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(CDR3B, TCRlib_ID_plot, criteria_simplified)
pie_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b_data <- sc_fc_rank %>%
  mutate(CDR3B = as.character(CDR3B)) %>%
  distinct(CDR3B) %>%
  inner_join(criteria_by_CDR3B, by = "CDR3B") %>%
  dplyr::count(criteria_simplified, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    criteria_simplified = factor(criteria_simplified, levels = criteria_simplified),
    percent = 100 * n / sum(n),
    label = paste0(criteria_simplified, ": ", n, " (", round(percent, 1), "%)")
  )
p_pie_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b <- ggplot(pie_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b_data,
                                      aes(x = "", y = n, fill = criteria_simplified)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
           colour = "black",
           linewidth = 0.15) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y",
              direction = -1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = criteria_colors,
                    breaks = levels(pie_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b_data$criteria_simplified),
                    labels = pie_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b_data$label,
                    drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = paste0("TCRlib-matching CDR3β\nn = ", sum(pie_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b_data$n)),
       x = NULL,
       y = NULL,
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
        legend.key.size = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
plots_list[["pie_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b"]] <- p_pie_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b
```

# fig. S4c

Longitudinal trajectories of CDR3Bs matching TCR library IDs, separated by category.

```{r}

patient <- pbl$RIO136
clonotype_by <- "aminoAcid"
floor_y <- 1e-3
tp_levels <- tcr_timepoint_levels(patient)
tp_days <- tcr_timepoint_days(tp_levels)
matching_cdr3b_criteria <- sc_fc_rank %>%
  mutate(CDR3B = as.character(CDR3B)) %>%
  distinct(CDR3B) %>%
  inner_join(criteria_by_CDR3B %>%
               dplyr::select(CDR3B, criteria_simplified),
             by = "CDR3B") %>%
  mutate(
    criteria_simplified = factor(criteria_simplified,
                                 levels = names(criteria_colors))
  )
plot_data_tcrlib_matching_traj <- bind_rows(patient, .id = "timepoint") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = tp_levels),
    day = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(timepoint))),
    clone_raw = as.character(.data[[clonotype_by]]),
    CDR3B = stringr::str_extract(clone_raw, "^[^_]+")
  ) %>%
  filter(CDR3B %in% matching_cdr3b_criteria$CDR3B) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, day, CDR3B) %>%
  summarise(
    count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    freq_in = sum(freq_in, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(expand_grid(timepoint = factor(tp_levels, levels = tp_levels),
                         CDR3B = matching_cdr3b_criteria$CDR3B),
             by = c("timepoint", "CDR3B")) %>%
  mutate(
    day = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(timepoint))),
    count = replace_na(count, 0),
    freq_in = replace_na(freq_in, 0),
    freq_pct = pmax(freq_in, floor_y)
  ) %>%
  left_join(matching_cdr3b_criteria, by = "CDR3B")
facet_labels <- plot_data_tcrlib_matching_traj %>%
  distinct(CDR3B, criteria_simplified) %>%
  dplyr::count(criteria_simplified, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(criteria_simplified, "\nn = ", n))
facet_labels <- setNames(facet_labels$label, facet_labels$criteria_simplified)
p_tcrlib_matching_traj_by_criteria <- ggplot(plot_data_tcrlib_matching_traj,
                                             aes(x = day,
                                                 y = freq_pct,
                                                 group = CDR3B,
                                                 colour = criteria_simplified)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = tp_days,
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.25,
             colour = "grey85") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.25,
            alpha = 0.65) +
  tcr_y_scale_log(floor_y = floor_y) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = tp_days) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = criteria_colors,
                      breaks = names(criteria_colors),
                      drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ criteria_simplified,
             ncol = 5,
             labeller = labeller(criteria_simplified = facet_labels)) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Frequency of unique\nCDR3β amino acid seq (%)",
       title = paste0("TCRlib-matching CDR3β trajectories | n = ",
                      n_distinct(plot_data_tcrlib_matching_traj$CDR3B))) +
  tcr_theme_trajectory(base_size = 8, aspect.ratio = 0.65) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "black"),
        panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.8, "lines"))
plots_list[["traj_tcrlib_matching_cdr3b_by_criteria"]] <- p_tcrlib_matching_traj_by_criteria

```

# fig. S6e

Internal control: Are the IDs unique to CD3 and CD3+PD-1, or are they restricted to PD-1 populations?

```{r}

reactive_levels <- c("Yes")

reactive_tcr_map <- tcr_lib %>%
  mutate(
    TCRlib_ID = as.character(V2),
    CDR3B = stringr::str_extract(V1, "^[^_]+")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    TCRlib_reactivity %in% reactive_levels | Traj_reactivity %in% reactive_levels,
    !is.na(TCRlib_ID), TCRlib_ID != "",
    !is.na(CDR3B), CDR3B != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(TCRlib_ID, CDR3B)

repertoire_trb_long <- repertoire %>%
  mutate(cell_id = paste(sample, barcode, sep = "_")) %>%
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cols = c(v_gene, j_gene, cdr3, chain), delim = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(v_gene, j_gene, cdr3, chain), stringr::str_trim),
    CDR3B = cdr3,
    population = case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(sample, stringr::regex("bulk", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "CD3+",
      stringr::str_detect(sample, stringr::regex("pd1", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "CD3+PD1hi",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    chain == "TRB",
    !is.na(CDR3B), CDR3B != "",
    population %in% c("CD3+", "CD3+PD1hi")
  ) %>%
  distinct(cell_id, sample, population, CDR3B)

reactive_tcr_cell_counts <- repertoire_trb_long %>%
  inner_join(reactive_tcr_map, by = "CDR3B") %>%
  group_by(TCRlib_ID, population) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n_distinct(cell_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    TCRlib_ID,
    population = c("CD3+", "CD3+PD1hi"),
    fill = list(n_cells = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id_num = readr::parse_number(TCRlib_ID)
  )

id_order <- reactive_tcr_cell_counts %>%
  distinct(TCRlib_ID, id_num) %>%
  arrange(id_num) %>%
  pull(TCRlib_ID)

reactive_tcr_cell_counts <- reactive_tcr_cell_counts %>%
  mutate(
    TCRlib_ID = factor(TCRlib_ID, levels = id_order),
    population = factor(population, levels = c("CD3+", "CD3+PD1hi"))
  )

population_cols <- c(
  "CD3+" = "#9CCB8B",
  "CD3+PD1hi" = "#5E8F68"
)

plots_list[["bar_reactive_tcr_id_cells_cd3_pd1"]] <- ggplot(
  reactive_tcr_cell_counts,
  aes(x = TCRlib_ID, y = n_cells, fill = population)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(n_cells > 0, n_cells, "")),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = -0.25,
    size = 2.4,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = population_cols,
    breaks = c("CD3+", "CD3+PD1hi"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of cells",
    fill = NULL,
    title = "Reactive TCR IDs across CD3+ and CD3+PD1hi populations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5, colour = "black"),
    aspect.ratio = 0.6
  )

plots_list[["bar_reactive_tcr_id_cells_cd3_pd1"]]
```

# tumor freq rank

And annotations of tumor-reactive or autoreactive IDs.

```{r}
reactivity_colors <- c(
  "Yes" = "red3",
  "No" = "black",
  "Auto-reactive" = "#E69F00",
  "EBV" = "#3c4b99",
  "CMV" = "seagreen3",
  "TCR library tested" = "gray60",
  "NA" = "gray80"
)
tcr_shapes <- c(
  "ID.082" = 35,
  "ID.746" = 6,
  "ID.525" = 38,
  "ID.640" = 0,
  "ID.024" = 5
)
# --- Parameters ---
patient <- "RIO136"
biopsy_sample <- "p136-Tfrozen_TCRB in frame"
autoreactive_ids <- c(
  "ID.082",
  "ID.525"
)
reactive_ids <- c(
  "ID.746",
  "ID.640",
  "ID.024"
)
# --- Prepare selected TCR annotation ---
tcr_annotation <- tcr_lib %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    aminoAcid = stringr::str_remove(
      stringr::str_trim(as.character(V1)),
      "_.*$"
    ),
    TCR_ID = stringr::str_trim(as.character(V2)),
    reactivity = case_when(
      TCR_ID %in% autoreactive_ids ~ "Auto-reactive",
      TCR_ID %in% reactive_ids ~ "Reactive",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(aminoAcid),
    aminoAcid != "",
    !is.na(TCR_ID),
    !is.na(reactivity)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    aminoAcid,
    reactivity
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    TCR_ID = paste(
      unique(TCR_ID),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# --- Rank biopsy clonotypes ---
biopsy_rank <- biopsy[[patient]][[biopsy_sample]] %>%
  mutate(
    aminoAcid = stringr::str_trim(
      as.character(aminoAcid)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(aminoAcid),
    aminoAcid != "",
    !is.na(freq_in),
    is.finite(freq_in),
    freq_in > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(aminoAcid) %>%
  summarise(
    count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    freq_in = sum(freq_in, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(freq_in),
    desc(count)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tcr_annotation,
    by = "aminoAcid"
  )
# --- Selected matched TCRs ---
biopsy_rank_labeled <- biopsy_rank %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(TCR_ID),
    !is.na(reactivity)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(
    TCR_ID,
    sep = "; "
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TCR_ID = stringr::str_trim(TCR_ID)
  )
# --- Check expected IDs ---
expected_ids <- c(
  autoreactive_ids,
  reactive_ids
)
matched_ids <- biopsy_rank_labeled %>%
  pull(TCR_ID) %>%
  unique()
missing_ids <- setdiff(
  expected_ids,
  matched_ids
)
if (length(missing_ids) > 0) {
  warning(
    "These TCR IDs were not found in the biopsy by amino-acid match: ",
    paste(missing_ids, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
# --- Plot ---
p_biopsy_rank <- ggplot(
  biopsy_rank,
  aes(
    x = rank,
    y = freq_in
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.2,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.45,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = biopsy_rank_labeled,
    aes(
      color = reactivity,
      shape = TCR_ID
    ),
    size = 2.5,
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = biopsy_rank_labeled,
    aes(
      label = TCR_ID,
      color = reactivity
    ),
    size = 2.6,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.linewidth = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Auto-reactive" = unname(
        reactivity_colors["Auto-reactive"]
      ),
      "Reactive" = unname(
        reactivity_colors["Yes"]
      )
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Auto-reactive",
      "Reactive"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = tcr_shapes,
    breaks = names(tcr_shapes),
    name = "TCR.ID"
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma,
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.02, 0.12)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Amino-acid clonotype rank",
    y = "Clonotype frequency (%)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 16,
        size = 2.5
      )
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        color = "black",
        size = 2.5
      )
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.25,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.15,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(
      1.5,
      "pt"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "black"
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      5,
      35,
      5,
      5
    ),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )
plots_list[["biopsy_rank"]] <- p_biopsy_rank
print(plots_list[["biopsy_rank"]])
```

```{r}
# --- Save annotated TCR library information for single-cell analysis ---
tcr_lib.annotated.save <- tcr_lib.annotated %>%
  dplyr::select(
    matched_ID = V2,
    TCRlib_reactivity,
    Traj_reactivity,
    criteria_simplified
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reactivity = case_when(
      TCRlib_reactivity == "Yes" | Traj_reactivity == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
      TCRlib_reactivity == "Auto-reactive" | Traj_reactivity == "Auto-reactive" ~ "Auto-reactive",
      TCRlib_reactivity %in% c("No", "No-autoreactivity-tested") |
        Traj_reactivity %in% c("No", "No-autoreactivity-tested") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-TCRlib_reactivity, -Traj_reactivity)
```

Save plots.

```{r}

datapath <- "/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/manuscript/illustrator/plots/tcrb/trajectories-final"
plots_dir <- file.path(datapath, "plots")

dir.create(
  plots_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

for (i in names(plots_list)) {
  out <- file.path(
    plots_dir,
    paste0(i, ".pdf")
  )

  if (is.null(plots_list[[i]])) {
    message("Skipping '", i, "': plot is NULL")
    next
  }

  tryCatch(
    {
      ggsave(
        filename = out,
        plot = plots_list[[i]],
        device = "pdf",
        width = 7.5,
        height = 7.5,
        units = "in",
        limitsize = FALSE
      )

      message("Saved: ", out)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      if (file.exists(out)) {
        unlink(out)
      }

      message(
        sprintf(
          "Skipping '%s': %s",
          i,
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
      )
    }
  )
}
```
